workspace.name: Chai & Chapter
workspace.description: Bookshop café serving cutting chai, filter coffee and all-day snacks in Bandra.
workspace.audience: Students and young professionals in Bandra who read, work and meet friends over chai

brand_kit.voice_tone: Warm, bookish and a little cheeky. Talks like the regular who knows every barista by name. Occasional Hinglish, never forced.
sample_posts: Rain outside, chai inside. Your corner table (and a slightly dog-eared Murakami) is waiting. ☕📚
Sunday reading circle, 9am. No talking, just pages turning and the charcoal crackling. Bring any book.
Bun maska restocked. Yes, the soft one. No, we won't judge if you order two.

workspace.name: LedgerLoop
workspace.description: Accounts-payable automation for Indian mid-market companies: invoice capture, three-way matching, Tally/Zoho sync.
workspace.audience: CFOs, finance controllers and AP managers at Indian companies with 200-2,000 employees

brand_kit.voice_tone: Clear, confident and practical. Speaks finance fluently but never hides behind jargon. Specific numbers over adjectives.
sample_posts: Month-end close shouldn't mean a week of chasing GRNs. Here's how one AP team got it down to two days.
Three-way matching sounds simple until 4% of your invoices have a rounding difference. Tolerance rules fix that.
GSTIN typos cost real money in ITC. We now flag them before a bill is approved.

workspace.name: Iron & Ease
workspace.description: Coached small-group strength training for beginners and people returning to exercise in Koramangala.
workspace.audience: Adults 28-55 in Bengaluru who feel intimidated by big gyms and want to get strong safely

brand_kit.voice_tone: Encouraging and plain-spoken. Celebrates small wins, never shames bodies, never promises transformations.
sample_posts: First deadlift today for Priya. 30 kg, perfect form, the biggest grin in the room.
You don't need to be fit to start. That's what the Foundations course is for.
Six people, one coach, zero mirrors-and-ego. Come see what strength training can feel like.

workspace.name: Kadak Tees
workspace.description: Mumbai streetwear label: graphic tees about everyday Bombay life, drawn in-house and sold in limited drops.
workspace.audience: 18-28 year old college students and young professionals in Mumbai, Pune and Bengaluru

brand_kit.voice_tone: Witty, warm Hinglish, like a friend from the same local train. Short punchy lines, Bombay slang (bindaas, ekdum, kadak), max two emojis. Self-aware humour, never mean.
